QGIVERS.name: FATMA TEYZE 🐱
chat: Pamuk says hello. She doesn't. But she thinks it. 🐱

QGIVERS.name: HALICI AHMET 🧶
chat: Nothing for sale today — for YOU, everything is free! ...No. But a good price.

QGIVERS.name: KAPTAN RIZA ⚓
chat: Nermin and I have çay every evening now. ⚓💌
The sea is calm today. Deniz sakin.

QGIVERS.name: MERT 📓
chat: I quit smoking, abla. For real this time. 😤
Page six is framed on my wall now. 📓

QGIVERS.name: HIZLI HAKAN 🚲
chat: Queen of the mountain. I say it with only a little pain. 🚲

intro: Kızım! Kızım! 😿 (My girl! My girl!)
My cat Pamuk ran off this morning. White, fluffy, judgemental. Pamuk means cotton.
The neighbours have seen her all over the hill. If you find her, take a photo — I just need to know she's all right!

steps.lab: Find Pamuk's three hiding spots and photograph her 🐱📸

outro: *she flicks through the photos* Maşallah! 😻 She's fine! She's just... everywhere.
Thank you, kızım. kedi = cat · fotoğraf = photo.

intro: She's by the swings at the playground now. But imps from the city have started chasing cats. 😾
Walk her home to me. Stay close — she only follows people she trusts.

steps.name: Pamuk
steps.lab: Walk Pamuk home — keep the imps off her 🐱

outro: PAMUK! 😻 *squeezes the cat, who tolerates it*
You are a good girl, Torii. Here — my late husband's sunglasses. He would want them to go somewhere stylish.

intro: To thank everyone who looked for Pamuk, I made lokum. 🍬
Take a box to Nuri, Hüseyin and Selim — quickly, before it goes sticky in the sun! Two and a half minutes.
outro: The whole hill smells of rosewater now. 🌹 Teşekkür ederim, kızım.
Take a box for yourself. And come for çay any time — Pamuk likes you. She won't show it. But she does.

intro: Hoş geldin, abla! 🧶 Remember me? You haggled me DOWN. Nobody haggles me down.
A customer wants my best kilim — a proper Istanbul teyze, Turkish only. Help me talk to her. We split the profit!

steps.q: "Merhaba kızım. Bu kilim ne kadar?" (Hello dear. How much is this rug?)

opts.r: It is the middle of the day, kızım.

steps.q: "Bin lira mı? Çok pahalı!" (A thousand? Too expensive!)

opts.t: Ama el yapımı! Sekiz yüz olsun.
opts.en: But it's handmade! Let's say eight hundred.

opts.r: ...Then go and eat, dear. After you sell me the rug.
Where are you going? I want the rug!

steps.q: "Tamam, alıyorum!" (Fine — I'll take it!) What do you say as she pays?
steps.hint: There is a special phrase for this in Turkish.

opts.en: Use it happily! (what you say after a sale)

opts.r: The rug is right here, kızım.

outro: Sekiz yüz lira! 💰 You are a natural. Half is yours — a deal is a deal.
Güle güle kullanın — "use it with joy". We say it every time something is sold. Now you know.

intro: ABLA! My cash box — gone! 😱 That kid in the hood just ran off with it!
He runs a loop through the west district — catch him before he disappears!

steps.lab: Catch the pickpocket with Ahmet's cash box 🏃
Bring the cash box back to Ahmet 💰

outro: *counts every lira twice* All there! Aferin! 👏
But the kid shouted something as he ran: "The Ağa wants his cut." ...That is not good, abla.

parts.n: Kara Çarşı Ağası · The Black Market Boss
intro: The Ağa runs the black market under the bazaar. Fake nazars, fake saffron, fake EVERYTHING.
Every trader pays him, or their stall "has an accident". Tonight he comes to collect. Stand with us?

phases.sub: He's throwing counterfeit coins — dodge the purple!
The pickpockets are back, and he's furious

steps.lab: Tell Ahmet the bazaar is free

outro: The whole çarşı is cheering! 🎉 Nobody pays the Ağa ever again.
And look — his famous gold chain. He won't be needing it. It's yours.

intro: Ahoy, genç kız! ⚓ Kaptan Rıza. Forty years on the water. The ferry never beats me — and it never will.
My knees are done, though. Race the ferry for me: over the bridge, the far bank and back. On your bike!

steps.lab: Race the ferry: bridge, far bank, back 🚲⛴

outro: HA! The ferry is still tying up and you are already back! 😂
Kaptan is the same word in Turkish, you know. Some things need no translation.

intro: At night the old sailors come back. Ghosts, genç kız — my old crew. 👻
Nobody at the yacht club believes me. Bring me photos. Three. Then send them back to sleep.
outro: *squints at the photo* ...That is Hasan. He still owes me fifty lira. 😤
Thank you. They can rest now. And the yacht club can eat their words.

intro: One more thing, and it is the hardest. 💌
Forty years ago I wrote a letter to Nermin. I never sent it. She drinks her çay outside Five Sips every evening.
Take it to her — quickly, before I lose my nerve and call you back!

steps.lab: Get the letter to Nermin Hanım at Five Sips — fast! 💌⏱
Go back and tell the Kaptan 💌

outro: *he can't sit still* ...Well? What did she say?
... "Neden bu kadar geç kaldın?" — "What took you so long?" 😭⚓
Here — my ship's bell. For your bicycle. You earned it, kaptan.

intro: Abla! It's me, Mert. Yes — the "sigara içen insan sağlıklı insandır" Mert. I have since learned. 😬
The wind took my Turkish notebook — the one I made for people learning the language. Five pages, all over Midtown. Help me find them?

steps.lab: Find Mert's 5 notebook pages around Midtown 📄
pages: I want to go to Antalya.

steps.lab: Bring the pages back to Mert 📓

outro: All five! Wait... these sentences are all about you. 😳
...I may have written this notebook after I met you at Old Soul. It is a very good notebook. Shh.

intro: A notebook is useless if nobody learns from it. Let me test you, abla. Two questions. Bandit is watching — no cheating.

steps.q: "Antalya'ya gitmek istiyorum." — what does it mean?

opts.t: I want to go to Antalya.

steps.q: How do you say "My dog's name is Bandit"?

opts.r: Mükemmel! (Perfect!) köpek → köpeğim → köpeğimin: the k softens to ğ.
All the words, none of the order. 😅
Bandit is going to be very offended. kedi = cat! 🐱
değil = NOT. Bandit is very cute — take that back!

outro: İkisi de doğru! Both right! You'll be fluent by summer, abla. ☕

intro: There was a sixth page. The most important one. An imp just snatched it off my table and RAN. 😤
It's heading for the park! Get it back!

steps.lab: Chase the imp with the last page 👹📄

outro: *unfolds it* ...It's the last sentence of the notebook.
"Bu defteri Torii için yazdım." — "I wrote this notebook for Torii." 🥹
Keep these glasses too. They were my grandfather's. He was a teacher. He would have liked you.

QUESTS.t: DAĞIN KRALI · KING OF THE MOUNTAIN

intro: Ooo, a Diamond Back. 😏 I'm Hızlı Hakan — "Fast Hakan". This mountain is MINE.
Think you can ride to the top in under 80 seconds? The rings show the way. Go on, surprise me.

steps.lab: Ride to the top of Işıkdağ in time ⛰🚲

outro: Huh. Not bad for a city girl. Fena değil. (Not bad.)
But anyone can go UP. Real riders race DOWN.

intro: Summit to my garage, you and me. Loser buys the çay. 🏁
Meet me at the top.

steps.lab: Ride up to the summit to meet Hakan ⛰

outro: ...I let you win. 😤 *he did not let you win*
The çay is on me. Kazandın! — you won.

parts.n: Dağın kralı · King of the mountain
intro: Okay. Rematch. Winner takes the title — and my chain.
...Also, I MAY have let some öküz loose on the road to slow you down. Totally fair. 🐂

steps.lab: Clear the 3 öküz Hakan set loose 🐂

steps.bn: DAĞIN KRALI · KING OF THE MOUNTAIN
steps.lab: Beat Hakan to the summit — for the title 👑

outro: *sits on the cairn, out of breath* ...Dağın kraliçesi. Queen of the mountain. Fair and square.
Take it. The Işıkdağ chain. It never slips — unlike me, apparently.
